thesis: Selected wealth advice includes the value of time and a broader purpose for resources.
summary: The reviewed passages introduce an income-based hourly-rate heuristic and later describe wealth as relationships, environment, and stewardship as well as money. The formula is a starting point for thought, not a complete delegation calculation. The note does not adopt claims that identity alone determines wealth.

insights.title: Use an explicit estimate when considering delegation
insights.explanation: The creator divides annual income by assumed working hours. Actual marginal earning capacity and cash affordability can differ from this average.

insights.title: Consider what resources enable for other people
insights.explanation: The creator frames money, time, and attention as resources to deploy, not merely accumulate. This is a stated value rather than a measured outcome.
